name: Goffredo Zehender
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, long narrow face, thin moustache, slim build, watchful expression
bio: Goffredo 'Freddie' Zehender began with Chrysler, then Bugatti, and spent most of his career with Alfa Romeo as a works and private entrant. He won the 1932 Grand Prix du Comminges with a private 8C 2300 Monza and raced Maseratis from 1934, one of the most reliable privateers of the decade.
